name: Meganium

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.text: Each Basic Grass Energy attached to all of your Pokémon provides GrassGrass Energy. The effect of Wild Growth doesn't stack.

flavorText: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

name: Inteleon

attacks.name: Bring Down
attacks.text: Choose a Pokémon in play (yours or your opponent's) that has the least HP remaining, except for this Pokémon, and it is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Water Shot
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents—like their body heat—then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

name: Alakazam

abilities.name: Psychic Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Powerful Hand
attacks.text: Place 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each card in your hand.

flavorText: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It's said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

name: Lunatone

abilities.name: Lunar Cycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic Fighting Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn.

flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Drifloon

attacks.name: Pull
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

flavorText: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Drifblim

attacks.name: Creepy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Balloon Return
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

flavorText: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Psyduck

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.

flavorText: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.text: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

flavorText: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Alakazam

abilities.name: Psychic Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Powerful Hand
attacks.text: Place 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each card in your hand.

flavorText: Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It's said that this Pokémon used these powers to create the spoons it holds.

name: Riolu

attacks.name: Accelerating Stab
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Accelerating Stab.

flavorText: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Solar Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic Grass Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jungle Dump
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

name: Ceruledge

attacks.name: Infernal Slash
attacks.text: Discard 4 Basic Fire Energy cards from your hand. If you can't discard 4 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Zacian

attacks.name: Limit Break
attacks.text: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavorText: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

name: Flygon

abilities.name: Sandy Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

name: Toxtricity

abilities.name: Sinister Surge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Basic Darkness Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

flavorText: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

flavorText: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy—altogether top quality.

name: Whimsicott

attacks.name: Healing Fluff
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Sneasel
flavorText: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

name: Weavile

attacks.name: Retaliatory Claw
attacks.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 50 or less, this attack does 170 more damage.

flavorText: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Charcadet

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Mega Charizard X ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Inferno X
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fire Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Oricorio ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Excited Turbo
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, if you have any Fire Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Fire Pokémon.

name: Mega Kangaskhan ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Run Errand
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Run Errand Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Rapid-Fire Combo
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.

name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Soothing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 120 damage from 1 of your Benched Psychic Pokémon.

flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Haunter
flavorText: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Celebratory Fanfare
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon. If a player healed any damage in this way, their turn ends.

name: Mega Charizard X ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Inferno X
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Fire Energy from among your Pokémon, and this attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 280 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: N's Zekrom

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rampaging Thunder
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

flavorText: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Mega Gardevoir ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Overflowing Wishes
attacks.text: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Psychic Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Mega Symphonia
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.text: Attach up to 3 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Mega Brave
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave.

rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Giant Bouquet
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon.

name: Mega Emboar ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Crimson Blast
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

name: Mega Feraligatr ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mortal Crunch
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 200 more damage.

name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Turtwig
flavorText: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Piplup
flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Rowlet
flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Litten

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Popplio

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

name: Cyndaquil
flavorText: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Totodile
flavorText: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: Snivy
flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Tepig

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Oshawott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Grookey
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Double Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Sobble
flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Treecko
flavorText: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

name: Torchic
flavorText: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

name: Mudkip
flavorText: The fin on Mudkip's head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

name: Chespin

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Fennekin
flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froakie
flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Sprigatito
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Fuecoco

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Quaxly
flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Serperior

attacks.name: Regal Command
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Solar Coiling
attacks.text: If Rosa's Encouragement is in your discard pile, this attack does 150 more damage.

flavorText: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

name: Barbaracle

abilities.name: Stone Arms
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fighting Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Fighting Pokémon.

flavorText: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

name: Tyrantrum

abilities.name: Tyrannically Gutsy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, it gets +150 HP.

attacks.name: Wreak Havoc
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million years ago. Nothing could stop it.

name: Doublade

attacks.name: Weaponized Swords
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Honedge, Doublade, and Aegislash from your hand, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.

flavorText: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Makuhita
flavorText: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

name: Chikorita
flavorText: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

name: Tyrunt

attacks.name: Get Angry
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Mega Zygarde ex

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Nullifying Zero
attacks.text: For each of your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 150 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Mega Clefable ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shooting Moons
attacks.text: You may discard up to 4 Energy cards from your hand, and this attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

name: Mega Gengar ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.text: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Void Gale
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Delphox

abilities.name: Flaring Magic
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Energized Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to all Pokémon.

flavorText: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Synchro Pulse
abilities.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, attacks used by this Pokémon do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Flashing Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Flashing Bolt.

flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Crobat

abilities.name: Nighttime Maneuvers
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a card. Shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.

attacks.name: Poison Sound Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

flavorText: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Goodra

abilities.name: Slimy Sliding
abilities.text: When your opponent's Active Pokémon retreats, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, Energy for its Retreat Cost is not discarded, and they don't switch Pokémon. The effect of Slimy Sliding doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

flavorText: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Toxel

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

name: Charmeleon
flavorText: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Fennekin

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Mega Greninja ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Mortal Shuriken
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may discard a Basic Water Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Place 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ninja Spinner
attacks.text: You may put a Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand and have this attack do 80 more damage.

name: Miraidon

abilities.name: Photon Cord
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

name: Slowbro

attacks.name: All Out
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 160 more damage.

flavorText: An attached Shellder won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of Slowbro's tail.

name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Vengeful Anchor
attacks.text: If you have 4 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, this attack does 140 more damage.

flavorText: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Bastiodon

abilities.name: Ancient Bulwark
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to each of your Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have 2 or less Energy attached.

flavorText: Bastiodon live in herds. When assaulted by enemies, they line up side by side and use their hard faces to block attacks.

name: Slowpoke

abilities.name: Dopey Face
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Confused.

flavorText: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Binacle

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

flavorText: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Zarude

attacks.name: Overhead Throw
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Shadowy Whip
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any Shadowy Darkness Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Mega Zeraora ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage for each Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zepto Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

name: Mega Darkrai ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dusk Raid
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 110 more damage.

attacks.name: Abyss Eye
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, it is Knocked Out.

name: Mega Dragonite ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Sky Transport
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ryuno Glide
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Paradise Resort
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Psyduck in play (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless less.

name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Scrappy Spark
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Alolan Exeggutor

abilities.name: Scale Up
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 6 or more Grass Energy attached, it gets +250 HP.

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon

flavorText: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

name: Lucario

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Moltres

abilities.name: Fiery Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Articuno and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Articuno

abilities.name: Frosty Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Zapdos

abilities.name: Flash-Pop Flapping
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Articuno in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thundering Lightning
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

flavorText: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

name: Greninja ex
rules: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Stealthy Slash
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

name: Sylveon ex
rules: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Colorful Harmony
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each type of Basic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

name: Nidorina

abilities.name: Share Happiness
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

name: Victini

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Zeraora

attacks.name: Rapid Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Electrobullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Empower
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psydrive
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

name: Mew

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Ditto

attacks.name: Surprisingly Transform
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Pikachu ex
rules: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Pika-Pika Parade
attacks.text: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

name: Espeon ex
rules: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Solar Beatdown
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

name: Pikachu ex
rules: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Zip-Zap Frenzy
attacks.text: You may attach any number of Basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

name: Umbreon ex
rules: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Lunatic Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 140 more damage.

name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Frightening Pattern
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

flavorText: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Magmortar

abilities.name: Buddy Boost
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic Fire Energy card, a Basic Lightning Energy card, or 1 of each from your hand to your Electivire and Magmortar in any way you like.

flavorText: They dwell in volcanic craters. It's said that only a single pair of Magmortar will inhabit any given volcano.

name: Enamorus

abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rising Heart
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

flavorText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Kommo-o

abilities.name: Beat Scales
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your Dragon Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

flavorText: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

name: Spritzee

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavorText: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked.

name: Seel
flavorText: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.

name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Brutal Whirlpool
attacks.text: If a Stadium that has "Legendary" in its name is in play, this attack also does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled ferociously against Groudon.

name: Mega Rayquaza ex
rules: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Ruler's Roar
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to this Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Storm Emerald
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each Fire Energy and each Lightning Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

name: Celebratory Fanfare
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon. If a player healed any damage in this way, their turn ends.

name: Pokémon RUN Pikachu

attacks.name: Let's Run Together!
attacks.text: Each player draws a card.

flavorText: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges electricity.
